jade.monstergirls.milk_full: Uncomfortably full: needs a milking machine
journal.monstergirls.guide.nursing.title: Nursing
journal.monstergirls.guide.nursing: A mother with milk nurses her baby every few minutes. Feed the baby by hand to wean her; never weaned, her mother keeps her milk for good. Mothers foster orphans of any kind. Poisoned or withering under a roof? A friend with milk brings you a cup.

message.monstergirls.rescue_drink: You drink %s's milk: the poison fades

advancement.monstergirls.every_legend.de: Befriend every one of the 55 legendary creatures
journal.monstergirls.guide.legends.title: Legends
journal.monstergirls.guide.legends: Most kinds are common. The storied ones are rare. The figures of myth are legendary: only one of each comes to a region, she glints now and then, and she stays until befriended.
message.monstergirls.encounter.webbed: %s is caught in a web! Cut her free.
message.monstergirls.encounter.chased: %s is running from zombies, straight towards you!
message.monstergirls.encounter.lost: %s is lost in the rain. Lead her somewhere with a roof.
message.monstergirls.encounter.thanks: %s won't forget that you helped her.
advancement.monstergirls.every_rescue.de: Cut one free of a web, see off her chasers, and lead one in from the rain
journal.monstergirls.guide.encounters: Now and then you meet one in trouble: caught in a web, chased by zombies, or lost in the rain. Cut the web, fight off the chasers, or lead her under a roof, and she won't forget it. One found hurt mends with a healing balm.
journal.monstergirls.when.full_moon: Comes out under a full moon
message.monstergirls.order.patrol_chores: %s patrols here and does the chores
advancement.monstergirls.first_chore.des: Have a friend on patrol do a chore
advancement.monstergirls.every_chore.des: Have your friends gather eggs, take honey, shear sheep and catch fish
journal.monstergirls.guide.chores.title: Chores
journal.monstergirls.guide.chores: A friend you leave on patrol keeps the place: she gathers eggs, feathers and wool, takes the honey from full hives without upsetting the bees (put glass bottles in a chest for honey bottles), shears sheep, lights the dark corners with torches from a chest (so nothing spawns there), picks ripe sweet berries and glow berries, and fishes from the shore when there is nothing else to do. Plant girls and bugs on patrol tend the crops around their post too, a stage at a time. Food goes in a fridge nearby, the rest in a chest.

journal.monstergirls.guide.festivals: Every 24 days come three festivals: the Midsummer Dance on the 8th day, the Harvest Feast on the 16th and the Gift Exchange on the 24th. At dusk the girls who live at your hearth gather round it. Join them: play a jukebox for the dance, stock a fridge for the feast, and come empty-handed for the presents.
letter.monstergirls.enclosed: I've tucked something from here into the envelope. Don't lose it!
advancement.monstergirls.pen_pal.desc: Receive a letter from a friend on an expedition
letter.monstergirls.sea.0: The water out here is so clear I can see the bottom from the surface.
letter.monstergirls.sea.1: I followed a pod of dolphins all morning. They're terrible at sharing fish.
letter.monstergirls.sea.2: There's a sunken ship below me. I'm being brave and only looking.
letter.monstergirls.dark.0: The nights here are long and very quiet. I like it more than I thought.
letter.monstergirls.dark.1: I found an old graveyard where nobody remembers anybody. I tidied it a little.
letter.monstergirls.dark.2: A bat followed me for an hour. I think it wanted to be friends.
letter.monstergirls.wood.0: The trees here are older than any I've ever seen. They creak when they talk.
letter.monstergirls.wood.1: I slept in a hollow log last night and woke up covered in moss. Lovely.
letter.monstergirls.wood.2: The berries out here are the sweetest I've ever had. I saved you some.
letter.monstergirls.desert.0: The sand is so hot by day that I walk only at dawn and dusk.
letter.monstergirls.desert.1: I found a temple half-buried in the dunes. I didn't touch the pressure plate.
letter.monstergirls.desert.2: The stars over the desert are so bright you could read by them.
letter.monstergirls.east.0: The cherry trees are blooming. The petals get everywhere, even in my food.
letter.monstergirls.east.1: I stopped at a shrine and left an offering for your good luck.
letter.monstergirls.east.2: There's a hot spring up in the hills. I may have stayed in it far too long.
letter.monstergirls.swamp.0: It rained all day. I didn't mind at all.
letter.monstergirls.swamp.1: The frogs here sing all night. I joined in. They didn't mind either.
letter.monstergirls.swamp.2: I found a witch's hut. She wasn't home, so I left a note.
letter.monstergirls.ruins.0: I found old machinery under a hill, still ticking after all these years.
letter.monstergirls.ruins.1: Someone built a great wall here once. Only the copper is left, gone green.
letter.monstergirls.ruins.2: I counted the gears in a broken clock tower. There were four hundred and twelve.
letter.monstergirls.caves.0: The caves go down further than I dared to follow. I could hear water.
letter.monstergirls.caves.1: There's a cavern full of glowing berries. It looks like the night sky upside down.
letter.monstergirls.caves.2: I met a spider who was very polite, for a spider.
letter.monstergirls.plains.0: The grass is so tall here that I can hide in it standing up.
letter.monstergirls.plains.1: I passed a village. The farmers waved, and one of them gave me bread.
letter.monstergirls.plains.2: A herd of horses ran beside me for a while. I almost kept up.
message.monstergirls.market.arrives: A travelling %s has set up by your hearth. She trades the finds of her country for emeralds.
advancement.monstergirls.market_day.desc: Buy from a travelling girl at your hearth
journal.monstergirls.guide.market.title: Market Day
journal.monstergirls.guide.market: Every 6 days (the 4th, 10th, 16th and 22nd of the 24), if you are home that morning, a travelling girl from a family that doesn't live at your hearth sets up beside it, most often a kind you have never met. Hand her an emerald for a bundle of her country's finds; she has four to sell. She moves on the next day, unless you have made a friend of her.
journal.monstergirls.guide.rivals.title: Rivals
journal.monstergirls.guide.rivals: Some wild kinds can't stand each other, by their branch of the tree of life rather than their looks: cats, hyenas and mongooses with rodents, snakes with rodents and frogs, wolves and foxes with hares and rodents, spiders, bats and frogs with insects, seals and bears with fish, and the mongoose and meerkat with snakes. When they meet, one glowers and the other runs. Nobody gets hurt, and once a girl is your friend she has better things to do.
message.monstergirls.role.chosen: %s has grown up and wants to be a %s.
journal.monstergirls.guide.roles.title: Callings
journal.monstergirls.guide.roles: A daughter who grows up picks a calling from what she grew up around. Farmland makes a farmhand: crops grow faster where she tends them. A kitchen (furnace, smoker, campfire or fridge) makes a cook: now and then she cooks something raw in a fridge. A bell or an iron golem makes a guard, tougher and stronger. Otherwise she becomes a scout: her expeditions take half the time and bring more home.
journal.monstergirls.guide.teamwork: Two friends fighting the same foe set each other up: a blow within three seconds of a teammate's lands half again as hard. A harpy knocks the foe into the air, and a slime or spider girl slows it down.
advancement.monstergirls.teamwork.desc: Have two of your friends land a combined blow
journal.monstergirls.glimpsed: Only glimpsed so far. Watch her kind a while to learn more.
journal.monstergirls.watch_more: Watched %s of %s times. Keep watching, or make a friend of one, to learn her ways.
message.monstergirls.studied: Your journal page on the %s is complete
advancement.monstergirls.naturalist.desc: Fully study 25 kinds in your journal
journal.monstergirls.guide.bestiary: A kind you have only glimpsed gets just her name here. Watch her kind a while and her home and her moment fill in; watch longer, or befriend one, and you learn her ways. Fully study 25 kinds to be a naturalist.
message.monstergirls.birthday.thanks: %s is delighted you remembered her birthday!
advancement.monstergirls.birthday.desc: Bring a friend something to eat on her birthday
journal.monstergirls.guide.treats.title: Treats and Birthdays
journal.monstergirls.guide.treats: Every girl has a favourite treat from her homeland. She takes it even if it isn't what she usually eats, and it means three times as much. And every girl has a birthday on one of the 24 days of the calendar: bring a friend something to eat that day and she'll never forget it. Look at a friend to see her birthday.
message.monstergirls.comfort: %s rushes to your side and steadies you
message.monstergirls.hide.start: Count to ten! %s runs off to hide...
message.monstergirls.hide.won: %s wins hide and seek! She pops out of her hiding place, glowing with pride.
advancement.monstergirls.hide_and_seek.d: Find a friend playing hide and seek
Start a snowball fight with a friend
journal.monstergirls.guide.games.title: Games
journal.monstergirls.guide.games: Crouch and touch a friend with an empty hand to play hide and seek: count to ten while she hides, then find her within three minutes. Daughters love it most. Hit a friend with a snowball and she'll throw them right back for a while.

advancement.monstergirls.miner.desc: Have a friend come back from a mining trip
journal.monstergirls.guide.mining.title: Mining Trips
journal.monstergirls.guide.mining: Diggers (dwarves, gnomes, kobolds, moles, ants, constructs and more; look for "Miner") will mine for you. Hand one a pickaxe, then show her what to look for: an ore, raw metal, an ingot, a gem, coal or stone. She digs in at her patrol spot (or where she stands) and comes back there with a stack, into a chest beside the spot or into your hands. Rare things take days and wear the pickaxe; Efficiency, Fortune and Unbreaking help. Crouch with an empty hand to take your pickaxe back.

journal.monstergirls.guide.foraging: Gatherers (plants, rabbits, rodents, foxes, bugs, marsupials and centaurs; look for "Forager") will forage for you. Crouch and show one something that grows wild: berries, mushrooms, tar-shrooms, apples, flowers, saplings, seeds, honeycomb. She goes out and comes back to her patrol spot (or where she stood) with sixteen of it and your sample, into a chest beside the spot or into your hands. Berries take a few hours, rare seeds days.
journal.monstergirls.guide.longing.title: Longing
journal.monstergirls.guide.longing: Close friends miss you when you are away, and longing adds to it even while you are near. Tar-shrooms (black mushrooms of swamps and dark forests; they spread in the dark) make grown friends nearby long for you a little at a time, and a salami fed to one makes her long a lot. Leave for a minute or more and come back: if she misses you, she cuddles up to you, and is more likely to come to bed and to have young that day.

message.monstergirls.stargazing.star: A shooting star! Your friends make their wishes
message.monstergirls.stargazing.alone: A shooting star streaks across the sky
journal.monstergirls.guide.stargazing: On a clear night, stand still under open sky and look up at the stars. After a while your friends nearby come and sit beside you to look up. Before long a shooting star crosses the sky (one a night): everyone beside you grows a little closer, and one of them whispers her wish, which tells you her favourite treat. Each star falls through a constellation you haven't seen yet: the journal's cover keeps count of all twelve.

journal.monstergirls.guide.favours.title: Favours
journal.monstergirls.guide.favours: Now and then a grown friend near you asks you for something she needs: candles, string, paper, ingots, whatever her people use. Look at her to see what (it shows on her info). Bring it within three days, all at once or a few at a time, and hand it to her: she is glad of it, grows closer, and gives you a few emeralds. You only owe one favour at a time.

message.monstergirls.story.old: By the fire, %s tells an old story you have heard before, and tells it well
journal.monstergirls.guide.stories.title: Stories by the fire
journal.monstergirls.guide.stories: At night, sit by a lit campfire with two or more friends around it. One of them will tell a story (one a night), most often of a kind of her own branch of the tree of life that you haven't met, else one from her own people: its page opens in your journal, with where it lives. Everyone listening grows a little closer.

journal.monstergirls.guide.colds.title: Colds
journal.monstergirls.guide.colds: Leave a girl out in the rain or snow somewhere cold for a few minutes and she may catch a cold (sea folk, the undead, constructs and slimes never do). She sneezes and is a little slow for three days. Hand her mushroom stew, beetroot soup, rabbit stew or a honey bottle and she feels better at once, and is grateful to whoever looked after her.

journal.monstergirls.guide.visits.title: Daily visits
journal.monstergirls.guide.visits: Friends notice when you come by. The first time each day you are near one, she is glad to see you (a little closer), and counts the days in a row. Every week without a day missed she tells you so and grows closer still. Her info shows the count.

journal.monstergirls.guide.watch.title: Keeping watch
journal.monstergirls.guide.watch: A friend on patrol keeps watch at night: when you are away and a monster comes near her post, she calls out to you with where it is. If a grown friend dies, a poppy with her name falls where she did, and your journal's cover remembers her.

journal.monstergirls.guide.tree.title: The tree of life
journal.monstergirls.guide.tree: Every kind belongs to a branch of the tree of life: cats with hyenas and mongooses, whales with hippos, salamanders with frogs. A body can fool you (the hyena runs like a dog), her branch decides her milk. The pages after the guide keep count of each branch you have started; meet every kind on one branch to complete it and earn its charm (in your offhand it lends that branch's milk's first effect). Your first friend of a kind gets talked about: wild ones of her branch nearby start a little fond of you. When a branch is down to its last kind or two, a 'Still to meet' page tells you where they live (but not who they are).

journal.monstergirls.guide.rain.title: Sun and rain
journal.monstergirls.guide.rain: Cats of every kind hate getting wet: caught in the rain with nowhere to be, a feliform looks for a roof nearby and waits it out. Frogs, newts and salamanders love it, and a friend of theirs who stands out in the rain with them grows a little closer (once a shower). Friends warn you a minute before it starts. Snakes, lizards, turtles and crocodiles are cold-blooded: on a clear morning they lie in the sun for a while and get up warmed through, and a friend who keeps them company there is a little closer.
message.monstergirls.basking: %s stretches out in the sun beside you
message.monstergirls.moon_howl: %s howls at the full moon, and you feel it in your bones
journal.monstergirls.guide.habits.title: Habits
journal.monstergirls.guide.habits: Each branch has its habits. Wolves, dogs and foxes howl at the full moon, and every canid in earshot answers; stand under the moon with a friend among them and you are closer for it. Monkeys and apes groom a friend beside them, picking out poison, hunger or the like now and then. Elephants and their kin spray a burning friend out. Walk beside a hoofed friend (cattle, goats, deer, camels, horses) and you find your footing the way she does, stepping up whole blocks without a jump. Bears, raccoons and their furry kin wrap up a friend who is freezing. Crabs, lobsters and shrimp comb the beach: stand on the sand by the water and one digs up something at your feet now and then. Fairies, pixies and the leshy leave fairy rings of mushrooms on the grass at night; stand in one (any ring of mushrooms will do) and you are lucky till morning. Hares and rabbits hear trouble first: one thumps the ground when a monster comes, and you learn what it is and which way. Fall beside a slime friend and you land on her, softly. With one of the made folk beside you, an anvil you work never wears down.

Any egg laid within four blocks of it, by a chicken or a harpy, goes into the hay instead of rolling about. Take the eggs out with an empty hand, or let a hopper do it; a friend on patrol nearby empties it into the fridge.

journal.monstergirls.guide.orders.title: Orders and getting around
journal.monstergirls.guide.orders: A stick gives a friend her orders: sit, patrol, follow or roam; sneak with it for her stance. Sneak with the whistle and everyone near stays put; do it again and they all follow you. Followers go through portals with you, take the free seat in your boat, and wait where they are while you are away. Sneak with the friend compass and the friends near you glow. Your arrows and blasts pass them by, and you hear it when one is badly hurt. The command /monstergirls friends lists them all, wherever they are.

journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.title: The Demon Realm
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm: Deep in some dark forests and swamps (where a little shrine of black stone and purple candles sometimes keeps the realm's gifts), and wherever a wild Lilith lives, the ground turns to purple Demon Realm grass, and it creeps on by itself in the dark, a few steps past where it began, up into the trees, which weep violet sap; pale weepcaps glow among the roots, and the air turns heavy and rose-dark. Friends standing in it blush, miss you more and flirt more often. Its heartfruit bushes bear fruit: a close friend who eats one is lovestruck with you for a few minutes. Animals and monsters that linger on it in the dark change into monster girls of their kind: a witch into a succubus, a cow into a holstaur, an iron golem into a golem, a slime into a slime girl; a tamed pet stays devoted to you. Parrots become macaw harpies and frogs frog girls. Villagers, wandering traders, pigs, cats and chickens are possessed instead: they keep their own shape, but their eyes glow violet and the realm's haze rises from them, and possessed animals seek out one of their own kind every half day, and their young are born piglettes, nekomata or poultry harpies. A possessed villager or wandering trader comes to a sleeping player's bed instead: one who spends the night there has a little succubus or demon a day later, devoted to that player. Give one a heartfruit and she seeks your bed that night from far off (and if she is slow, she slips in through the haze); and she speaks well of her young's father to the village. A possessed cat brings her owner a heartfruit each morning. Possessed animals follow a heartfruit held out to them, and one fed to any possessed creature makes her ready for her own kind at once. At night a possessed villager passes it on to a villager standing close by, so a village slowly turns. Little patches of the realm take root under them, and a golem among three of them turns too. Splash holy water (holy water and gunpowder), thrown, frees every possessed creature where it breaks. A holy font (calcite, holy water and gold) wards twelve blocks round it: the realm can't take hold there and nobody is possessed or turned. Now and then a wandering trader arrives already possessed, with a realm explorer map among her wares. Holy water drives it out of them. A holstaur fills a glass bottle with her milk, which makes you strong; baked into a heartfruit tart with heartfruit, wheat and sugar, it leaves a close friend lovestruck three times as long. Deep in the realm at night a wild succubus or demon sometimes steps out of the haze, and under a full moon the realm spreads fast and its own dance the sabbath. Changed ones still burn with the realm, and slip into any sleeper's bed, friend or not. A succubus near your bed visits your dreams: a close one brings a sweet dream and a lucky morning; a wild one feeds on some of your experience and leaves a heartfruit, unless a tapir guards your sleep. A realm censer (chain, iron, heartfruit and an amethyst shard) fed a heartfruit burns for a day, and the girls within eight blocks of it feel the realm's air without its ground: they flirt and miss you as if they stood in it. A realm log cut down and kept makes dark purple realm planks, stairs, slabs, fences, gates, doors and trapdoors that stay purple in any light. (/monstergirls locate realm finds the nearest wild patch.) Torchlight turns it back to grass, and so does holy water (three bottles, a water bucket and a gold nugget). Silk touch takes the grass home.

journal.monstergirls.guide.season.title: Mating season
journal.monstergirls.guide.season: Each branch of the tree of life has three restless days in every forty, each at its own time. A grown friend in season stays close to you, blushes, flirts more and comes to bed more readily. Cold calms her: a cold biome, or a snowball or ice handed to her, which settles her until next season. Your friends list says who is in season.

journal.monstergirls.guide.marriage: A wedding ring (a diamond on three gold ingots) given to a grown friend who adores you, at full friendship, is a proposal. Stand by a hearth together and the wedding is held: your friends nearby gather round. A spouse forgives any absence, comes to bed more readily, and while she is near you have two more hearts. Every forty days she wears her veil again.
message.monstergirls.wardrobe.given: %s hugs the %s to her chest and puts it in her wardrobe
journal.monstergirls.guide.wardrobe: Give a friend clothes and she keeps them, and dresses for the moment over her own, whatever her shape: a raincoat in the rain, a winter coat in the cold, a yukata on a festival day, a maid's apron at home near her hearth.
journal.monstergirls.guide.liaison.title: The exchange liaison
journal.monstergirls.guide.liaison: Place an exchange desk (paper, a book, paper over planks) in a village and a villager takes it as the exchange liaison. She issues homestay permits and sells clothes and keepsakes. Carry a permit and iron golems leave your friends alone, and villagers who see you with a friend think better of you, so their prices drop.

commands.monstergirls.realm.possess.fail: Look at a grown villager, wandering trader, pig, cat or chicken
commands.monstergirls.realm.turn.fail: Look at a grown creature the realm can change
commands.monstergirls.realm.summon.fail: Nothing answers: stand on open ground, with no devil nearby
message.monstergirls.possessed.bed: %s slipped into your bed in the night, and left in the morning with a smile
message.monstergirls.possessed.promise: %s takes the heartfruit with a look that says: tonight
journal.monstergirls.guide.keepsakes.p1: A sketchbook draws a friend as a figurine for your shelf. A bedroll makes camp on the road. Every thirty days of close friendship she remembers, with presents.
journal.monstergirls.guide.keepsakes.p2: A close friend who wears your bracelet forgives a long absence more easily; a love letter gets one back; share an umbrella in the rain.
journal.monstergirls.guide.keepsakes.p3: Hold a flower in your other hand and open this journal to press it between the pages; it remembers the friend who was with you, and friends who know bring kinds you lack.
journal.monstergirls.guide.dairy.p1: Pour milk into a butter churn and work it, by hand or with redstone. Set it on a cheese shelf underground: it firms in a day and hardens in three, stronger each time.
journal.monstergirls.guide.dairy.p2: A fridge feeds the household; berries, honey, fish and the like flavour a friend's milk for a day, and so does food from your hand.
journal.monstergirls.guide.nursing.p1: A mother with milk nurses her baby every few minutes. Feed the baby by hand to wean her; never weaned, her mother keeps her milk for good. Mothers foster orphans of any kind. Poisoned or withering under a roof?
journal.monstergirls.guide.nursing.p2: A friend with milk brings you a cup.
journal.monstergirls.guide.chores.p1: A friend you leave on patrol keeps the place: she gathers eggs, feathers and wool, takes the honey from full hives without upsetting the bees (put glass bottles in a chest for honey bottles), shears sheep,
journal.monstergirls.guide.chores.p2: lights the dark corners with torches from a chest (so nothing spawns there), picks ripe sweet berries and glow berries, and fishes from the shore when there is nothing else to do.
journal.monstergirls.guide.chores.p3: Plant girls and bugs on patrol tend the crops around their post too, a stage at a time. Food goes in a fridge nearby, the rest in a chest.
journal.monstergirls.guide.festivals.p1: Every 24 days come three festivals: the Midsummer Dance on the 8th day, the Harvest Feast on the 16th and the Gift Exchange on the 24th. At dusk the girls who live at your hearth gather round it.
journal.monstergirls.guide.festivals.p2: Join them: play a jukebox for the dance, stock a fridge for the feast, and come empty-handed for the presents.
journal.monstergirls.guide.market.p1: Every 6 days (the 4th, 10th, 16th and 22nd of the 24), if you are home that morning, a travelling girl from a family that doesn't live at your hearth sets up beside it, most often a kind you have never met.
journal.monstergirls.guide.market.p2: Hand her an emerald for a bundle of her country's finds; she has four to sell. She moves on the next day, unless you have made a friend of her.
journal.monstergirls.guide.rivals.p1: Some wild kinds can't stand each other, by their branch of the tree of life rather than their looks: cats, hyenas and mongooses with rodents, snakes with rodents and frogs, wolves and foxes with hares and rodents, spiders,
journal.monstergirls.guide.rivals.p2: bats and frogs with insects, seals and bears with fish, and the mongoose and meerkat with snakes. When they meet, one glowers and the other runs. Nobody gets hurt, and once a girl is your friend she has better things to do.
journal.monstergirls.guide.roles.p1: A daughter who grows up picks a calling from what she grew up around. Farmland makes a farmhand: crops grow faster where she tends them.
journal.monstergirls.guide.roles.p2: A kitchen (furnace, smoker, campfire or fridge) makes a cook: now and then she cooks something raw in a fridge. A bell or an iron golem makes a guard, tougher and stronger.
journal.monstergirls.guide.roles.p3: Otherwise she becomes a scout: her expeditions take half the time and bring more home.
journal.monstergirls.guide.treats.p1: Every girl has a favourite treat from her homeland. She takes it even if it isn't what she usually eats, and it means three times as much.
journal.monstergirls.guide.treats.p2: And every girl has a birthday on one of the 24 days of the calendar: bring a friend something to eat that day and she'll never forget it. Look at a friend to see her birthday.
journal.monstergirls.guide.mining.p1: Diggers (dwarves, gnomes, kobolds, moles, ants, constructs and more; look for "Miner") will mine for you. Hand one a pickaxe, then show her what to look for: an ore, raw metal, an ingot, a gem, coal or stone.
journal.monstergirls.guide.mining.p2: She digs in at her patrol spot (or where she stands) and comes back there with a stack, into a chest beside the spot or into your hands. Rare things take days and wear the pickaxe; Efficiency, Fortune and Unbreaking help.
journal.monstergirls.guide.mining.p3: Crouch with an empty hand to take your pickaxe back.
journal.monstergirls.guide.foraging.p1: Gatherers (plants, rabbits, rodents, foxes, bugs, marsupials and centaurs; look for "Forager") will forage for you.
journal.monstergirls.guide.foraging.p2: Crouch and show one something that grows wild: berries, mushrooms, tar-shrooms, apples, flowers, saplings, seeds, honeycomb.
journal.monstergirls.guide.foraging.p3: She goes out and comes back to her patrol spot (or where she stood) with sixteen of it and your sample, into a chest beside the spot or into your hands. Berries take a few hours, rare seeds days.
journal.monstergirls.guide.longing.p1: Close friends miss you when you are away, and longing adds to it even while you are near.
journal.monstergirls.guide.longing.p2: Tar-shrooms (black mushrooms of swamps and dark forests; they spread in the dark) make grown friends nearby long for you a little at a time, and a salami fed to one makes her long a lot.
journal.monstergirls.guide.longing.p3: Leave for a minute or more and come back: if she misses you, she cuddles up to you, and is more likely to come to bed and to have young that day.
journal.monstergirls.guide.stargazing.p1: On a clear night, stand still under open sky and look up at the stars. After a while your friends nearby come and sit beside you to look up.
journal.monstergirls.guide.stargazing.p2: Before long a shooting star crosses the sky (one a night): everyone beside you grows a little closer, and one of them whispers her wish, which tells you her favourite treat.
journal.monstergirls.guide.stargazing.p3: Each star falls through a constellation you haven't seen yet: the journal's cover keeps count of all twelve.
journal.monstergirls.guide.favours.p1: Now and then a grown friend near you asks you for something she needs: candles, string, paper, ingots, whatever her people use. Look at her to see what (it shows on her info).
journal.monstergirls.guide.favours.p2: Bring it within three days, all at once or a few at a time, and hand it to her: she is glad of it, grows closer, and gives you a few emeralds. You only owe one favour at a time.
journal.monstergirls.guide.stories.p1: At night, sit by a lit campfire with two or more friends around it. One of them will tell a story (one a night), most often of a kind of her own branch of the tree of life that you haven't met, else one from her own people: its page opens in your journal,
journal.monstergirls.guide.stories.p2: with where it lives. Everyone listening grows a little closer.
journal.monstergirls.guide.colds.p1: Leave a girl out in the rain or snow somewhere cold for a few minutes and she may catch a cold (sea folk, the undead, constructs and slimes never do). She sneezes and is a little slow for three days.
journal.monstergirls.guide.colds.p2: Hand her mushroom stew, beetroot soup, rabbit stew or a honey bottle and she feels better at once, and is grateful to whoever looked after her.
journal.monstergirls.guide.tree.p1: Every kind belongs to a branch of the tree of life: cats with hyenas and mongooses, whales with hippos, salamanders with frogs. A body can fool you (the hyena runs like a dog), her branch decides her milk.
journal.monstergirls.guide.tree.p2: The pages after the guide keep count of each branch you have started; meet every kind on one branch to complete it and earn its charm (in your offhand it lends that branch's milk's first effect).
journal.monstergirls.guide.tree.p3: Your first friend of a kind gets talked about: wild ones of her branch nearby start a little fond of you. When a branch is down to its last kind or two, a 'Still to meet' page tells you where they live (but not who they are).
journal.monstergirls.guide.rain.p1: Cats of every kind hate getting wet: caught in the rain with nowhere to be, a feliform looks for a roof nearby and waits it out.
journal.monstergirls.guide.rain.p2: Frogs, newts and salamanders love it, and a friend of theirs who stands out in the rain with them grows a little closer (once a shower). Friends warn you a minute before it starts.
journal.monstergirls.guide.rain.p3: Snakes, lizards, turtles and crocodiles are cold-blooded: on a clear morning they lie in the sun for a while and get up warmed through, and a friend who keeps them company there is a little closer.
journal.monstergirls.guide.habits.p1: Each branch has its habits. Wolves, dogs and foxes howl at the full moon, and every canid in earshot answers; stand under the moon with a friend among them and you are closer for it.
journal.monstergirls.guide.habits.p2: Monkeys and apes groom a friend beside them, picking out poison, hunger or the like now and then. Elephants and their kin spray a burning friend out.
journal.monstergirls.guide.habits.p3: Walk beside a hoofed friend (cattle, goats, deer, camels, horses) and you find your footing the way she does, stepping up whole blocks without a jump. Bears, raccoons and their furry kin wrap up a friend who is freezing.
journal.monstergirls.guide.habits.p4: Crabs, lobsters and shrimp comb the beach: stand on the sand by the water and one digs up something at your feet now and then.
journal.monstergirls.guide.habits.p5: Fairies, pixies and the leshy leave fairy rings of mushrooms on the grass at night; stand in one (any ring of mushrooms will do) and you are lucky till morning.
journal.monstergirls.guide.habits.p6: Hares and rabbits hear trouble first: one thumps the ground when a monster comes, and you learn what it is and which way. Fall beside a slime friend and you land on her, softly.
journal.monstergirls.guide.habits.p7: With one of the made folk beside you, an anvil you work never wears down.
journal.monstergirls.guide.nesting.p1: Build a nesting box (planks around a bit of wheat) and set it down where your hens are. Any egg laid within four blocks of it, by a chicken or a harpy, goes into the hay instead of rolling about.
journal.monstergirls.guide.nesting.p2: Take the eggs out with an empty hand, or let a hopper do it; a friend on patrol nearby empties it into the fridge.
journal.monstergirls.guide.orders.p1: A stick gives a friend her orders: sit, patrol, follow or roam; sneak with it for her stance. Sneak with the whistle and everyone near stays put; do it again and they all follow you.
journal.monstergirls.guide.orders.p2: Followers go through portals with you, take the free seat in your boat, and wait where they are while you are away. Sneak with the friend compass and the friends near you glow.
journal.monstergirls.guide.orders.p3: Your arrows and blasts pass them by, and you hear it when one is badly hurt. The command /monstergirls friends lists them all, wherever they are.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p1: Deep in some dark forests and swamps (where a little shrine of black stone and purple candles sometimes keeps the realm's gifts), and wherever a wild Lilith lives, the ground turns to purple Demon Realm grass,
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p2: and it creeps on by itself in the dark, a few steps past where it began, up into the trees, which weep violet sap; pale weepcaps glow among the roots, and the air turns heavy and rose-dark.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p3: Friends standing in it blush, miss you more and flirt more often. Its heartfruit bushes bear fruit: a close friend who eats one is lovestruck with you for a few minutes.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p4: Animals and monsters that linger on it in the dark change into monster girls of their kind: a witch into a succubus, a cow into a holstaur, an iron golem into a golem, a slime into a slime girl; a tamed pet stays devoted to you.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p5: Parrots become macaw harpies and frogs frog girls. Villagers, wandering traders, pigs, cats and chickens are possessed instead: they keep their own shape, but their eyes glow violet and the realm's haze rises from them,
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p6: and possessed animals seek out one of their own kind every half day, and their young are born piglettes, nekomata or poultry harpies.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p7: A possessed villager or wandering trader comes to a sleeping player's bed instead: one who spends the night there has a little succubus or demon a day later, devoted to that player.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p8: Give one a heartfruit and she seeks your bed that night from far off (and if she is slow, she slips in through the haze); and she speaks well of her young's father to the village.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p9: A possessed cat brings her owner a heartfruit each morning. Possessed animals follow a heartfruit held out to them, and one fed to any possessed creature makes her ready for her own kind at once.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p10: At night a possessed villager passes it on to a villager standing close by, so a village slowly turns. Little patches of the realm take root under them, and a golem among three of them turns too.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p11: Splash holy water (holy water and gunpowder), thrown, frees every possessed creature where it breaks.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p12: A holy font (calcite, holy water and gold) wards twelve blocks round it: the realm can't take hold there and nobody is possessed or turned.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p13: Now and then a wandering trader arrives already possessed, with a realm explorer map among her wares. Holy water drives it out of them.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p14: A holstaur fills a glass bottle with her milk, which makes you strong; baked into a heartfruit tart with heartfruit, wheat and sugar, it leaves a close friend lovestruck three times as long.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p15: Deep in the realm at night a wild succubus or demon sometimes steps out of the haze, and under a full moon the realm spreads fast and its own dance the sabbath.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p16: Changed ones still burn with the realm, and slip into any sleeper's bed, friend or not.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p17: A succubus near your bed visits your dreams: a close one brings a sweet dream and a lucky morning; a wild one feeds on some of your experience and leaves a heartfruit, unless a tapir guards your sleep.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p18: A realm censer (chain, iron, heartfruit and an amethyst shard) fed a heartfruit burns for a day, and the girls within eight blocks of it feel the realm's air without its ground: they flirt and miss you as if they stood in it.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p19: A realm log cut down and kept makes dark purple realm planks, stairs, slabs, fences, gates, doors and trapdoors that stay purple in any light.
journal.monstergirls.guide.realm.p20: (/monstergirls locate realm finds the nearest wild patch.) Torchlight turns it back to grass, and so does holy water (three bottles, a water bucket and a gold nugget). Silk touch takes the grass home.
journal.monstergirls.guide.season.p1: Each branch of the tree of life has three restless days in every forty, each at its own time. A grown friend in season stays close to you, blushes, flirts more and comes to bed more readily.
journal.monstergirls.guide.season.p2: Cold calms her: a cold biome, or a snowball or ice handed to her, which settles her until next season. Your friends list says who is in season.
journal.monstergirls.guide.marriage.p1: A wedding ring (a diamond on three gold ingots) given to a grown friend who adores you, at full friendship, is a proposal. Stand by a hearth together and the wedding is held: your friends nearby gather round.
journal.monstergirls.guide.marriage.p2: A spouse forgives any absence, comes to bed more readily, and while she is near you have two more hearts. Every forty days she wears her veil again.
journal.monstergirls.guide.liaison.p1: Place an exchange desk (paper, a book, paper over planks) in a village and a villager takes it as the exchange liaison. She issues homestay permits and sells clothes and keepsakes.
journal.monstergirls.guide.liaison.p2: Carry a permit and iron golems leave your friends alone, and villagers who see you with a friend think better of you, so their prices drop.
journal.monstergirls.tiger_nekomata.sign: Ambush, fishing & roar: Crouched in bamboo or tall grass she is nearly invisible until she pounces (a strong opening strike). She catches fish in rivers and brings them to her favourites.
Her roar makes hostile mobs within 12 blocks flee for a few seconds.
journal.monstergirls.snow_leopard_nekoma: Cliff leaps & warm tail: She jumps across gaps up to six blocks and never takes fall damage.
A bonded snow leopard near you stops you freezing in powder snow; asleep beside you she wraps you in her tail (no freezing, Resistance I when you wake).
journal.monstergirls.lynx_nekomata.signa: Snowshoe paws & rabbit hunter: She never sinks into powder snow and moves at full speed on snow. She keeps rabbits away from your crops and brings you rabbit hide and rabbit's feet.
Watched for too long, she slips out of sight (she breaks line of sight and hides).
journal.monstergirls.cobra_lamia.signatu: Hood & snake charming: The hood display is a warning: back off and nothing happens; come closer and she spits venom (Blindness and Poison).
A jukebox within 16 blocks keeps her calm, and a bonded cobra sways to it (the existing music system).
Hunting web and phantom net: Wild, she strings cobwebs round the spot she settled on and goes for whatever they catch (players included) until fed meat.
Bonded, she spins a web at night by your bed instead; phantoms, bats and vexes are caught in it. It fades at dawn.
journal.monstergirls.unicorn_centaur.sig: Pure heart, healing horn: A player who has killed villagers or iron golems can never befriend her, and she keeps away from them. Her horn clears poison and wither from friends near her and speeds up the cure of zombie villagers.
journal.monstergirls.koi_mermaid.signatu: Good fortune & waterfall climb: A bonded koi in a pond within 32 blocks of you gives Luck (better fishing and loot). She swims up water columns.
Ten days at full devotion turns her into a dragon koi (a golden glow mask and longer fins).
journal.monstergirls.snapping_turtle_liz: Tongue lure: While she sits still in water she catches a fish now and then and drops it at her feet (cod or salmon, at most three lying around at a time). Hit her and she hides in her shell.
Her bite is the hardest in the family after the crocodile's.
